reported.title: No stop threshold / no hysteresis; pump only follows 45 cm start mark
reported.description: The control block at lines 71-78 only compares levelCm against START_CM (45.0) and turns the pump off in the else branch, so there is no 30.0 cm stop threshold and no latch between start and stop. Combined with the silence latch at lines 57-61 that is never cleared, the pump stays off after any D4 LOW event; measured D7 was not HIGH for 5000 ms starting at 3.00 s, 4500 ms at 5.50 s, and 5500 ms at 4.50 s while level was above 45 cm. D7 was in the wrong state for 4500 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 5.50 s: D7 was not HIGH for 4500 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: Output chatters because single-sample comparison has no hysteresis or filtering
reported.description: sampleLevelCm (lines 22-24) takes one raw ADC reading per 40 ms poll and lines 71-78 compare it directly to a single threshold, so any noise around 45 cm flips the pump on and off each poll. Measured D7 toggled 64 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.32 s (limit 2), 8 times starting at 1.00 s for a glitch spike, and 34 times starting at 520 ms for rapid oscillation. D7 toggled 64 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.32 s (limit 2), and 84 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

truth.description: Single 45 cm start level short-cycles the pump

truth_for_judge.description: Single 45 cm start level short-cycles the pump

exposing_checks.behaviour: D7 must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window (No short cycling)

judge_input.spec:
- Linear water-level sensor on A1 at 10 mV/cm; sump pump contactor on D7; silence pushbutton on D4 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Start the pump when level reaches 45.0 cm or higher; stop the pump when level falls to 30.0 cm or lower.
- Holding D4 LOW latches silence mode and keeps the pump OFF until reset (power cycle).
- Pump output must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Every 800 ms print `sump cm=<level> pump=<0|1> mute=<0|1>` with level to one decimal place.
- Apply pump start/stop within 500 ms of a sustained band crossing.
